column1: # Common engineering materials for the weight calculator.
# These are NOT mill-verified grade data. That lives in grades.csv behind the
# checked/pending gate and is joined in separately by build-weight-data.mjs
# where every density carries the bulletin it was read from. A row in THIS file
# is a nominal handbook density for a generic material a buyer sizes against -
# mild steel; SS 304; aluminium 6061 - which no mill bulletin in this repo
# covers because this business does not stock them.
# The calculator labels the two tiers differently on the page
# tell a figure read off a mill bulletin from a handbook one. Do not blur them
# by writing a mill name into the source column here.
# What the source column may say:
#   CRC Handbook   - a pure element. Exact to the digits shown and not in
#                    dispute; these are the values every reference agrees on.
#   Nominal        - an alloy. Real tempers heats and castings vary by around
